title: 第一卷 第3章 运气不错
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华注意到淤泥里有动静。

    伸手挖淤泥，很快就抓出来一只青蟹。

    刚才没注意，直接伸手下去，手指头撞在青蟹壳上，还好感觉不对，他收了点劲，没直接把青蟹壳给戳烂。

    看淤泥还有动静。

    他扒了一下。

    又抓出来一只。

    这两只青蟹，一公一母，应该是两口子，这可比蛏子值钱多了。

    不过，他不打算卖，心里念叨：“这俩青蟹可以拿回家，侄子侄女应该会很喜欢吃。”

    侄子侄女现在也就五六岁。

    俩小馋猫。

    他没记错的话，最喜欢吃的就是螃蟹。

    别看住在小渔村，海鲜随处可见，但这青蟹也不是随便能吃到的，即便是运气好抓到，也是舍不得吃，要卖掉换钱。

    而家里的钱，大部分都被他这个不省心的二流子给祸害了。

    想想上一世的种种，他忍不住一阵懊悔，痛恨自己的所作所为。

    还好。

    如今，还来得及弥补。

    李华把青蟹扔水桶里，看了眼水桶，已经有个小半桶的海货。

    收获不错。

    李华感觉自己的体力，强的有些不太正常。

    忙活这一通，居然一点不感觉累。

    就是整的挺狼狈。

    张春妮也差不多。

    一扭头，看到几米外趴着一个晒太阳的青蟹。

    果断拿下。

    他感觉自己这运气不是一般的好。

    刚把青蟹放桶里，听到远处传来喊声：“李华，你还真带着张春妮跑到这里来了。”

    “赶紧过来。”

    “老子要和你算算账。”

    听到声音。

    李华扭头，看到张大雷，眼睛顿时红了。

    他永远也忘不了这个混蛋！

    上一世，就是这家伙散播谣言害了张春妮，也是这家伙设赌局，借钱给他，再赢走，导致他越陷越深。

    后来，这家伙三天两头到他家去闹，搅得家无宁日。

    如今。

    他不光要报恩，弥补过错，更要让这家伙付出惨重的代价。

    李华深吸一口气，压住满腔怒火，喊张春妮别挖了。

    阿青率先跑过来，低着头说道：“华哥，我没拦住。”
content_en:
Li Hua noticed movement in the mud.

    I reached out to dig in the mud and quickly caught a blue crab.

    He didn't pay attention just now, so he reached down and hit his finger on the blue crab shell. Fortunately, he felt something was wrong, so he calmed down a little and didn't directly smash the blue crab shell.

    Look at the mud and see if there is movement.

    He scratched it.

    Another one was caught.

    These two blue crabs, one male and one female, must be a couple. They are much more valuable than razor clams.

    However, he didn't plan to sell it, and thought to himself: "You can take these two blue crabs home. My nieces and nephews will probably like to eat them."

    My nieces and nephews are only five or six years old now.

    Two greedy cats.

    If he remembered correctly, his favorite food was crab.

    Even though you live in a small fishing village, seafood can be found everywhere, but blue crabs are not easily available. Even if you are lucky enough to catch them, you are reluctant to eat them and have to sell them for money.

    Most of the family's money was ruined by this careless second-rate man.

    Thinking about what happened in his previous life, he couldn't help feeling regretful and hating what he had done.

    fine.

    Now, there is still time to make amends.

    Li Hua threw the blue crabs into the bucket and looked at the bucket. There was already a small half bucket of seafood.

    Good harvest.

    Li Hua felt that his physical strength was abnormally strong.

    After all this busy work, I didn't feel tired at all.

    It's just quite embarrassing.

    Zhang Chunni is almost the same.

    Turning around, I saw a blue crab lying in the sun a few meters away.

    Take it decisively.

    He felt that his luck was unusually good.

    Just as I put the blue crabs in the bucket, I heard a shout from the distance: "Li Hua, you really came here with Zhang Chuni."

    "Come here quickly."

    "I want to settle a score with you."

    Hear sounds.

    Li Hua turned his head and saw Zhang Dalei, his eyes suddenly turned red.

    He will never forget this bastard!

    In the last life, it was this guy who spread rumors and harmed Zhang Chunni. It was also this guy who set up a bet, lent him money, and then won, causing him to get deeper and deeper into trouble.

    Later, this guy came to his house to cause trouble every three days, disturbing the peace of the family.

    now.

    Not only did he want to repay his kindness and make up for his mistakes, but he also wanted to make this guy pay a heavy price.

    Li Hua took a deep breath, suppressed his anger, and told Zhang Chunni to stop digging.

    Ah Qing ran over first, lowered his head and said, "Brother Hua, I didn't stop him."
